capabilities: View dozens of file formats in embedded viewers
Edit CSV cells, PDF pages, and images with write-back to the vault
Inspect ML model graphs, tensor metadata, and quantization summaries
Preview Jupyter notebooks, HAR captures, LaTeX, EPUB, and XML
Share files via encrypted upload links
extras: Most viewers have per-format input size limits (e.g. 256 MB for PDFs and notebooks, 64 MB for XML and fonts); several desktop features (RAR/7z extraction, ffmpeg transcoding, LibreOffice fallback) are unavailable on mobile; 3D mesh viewing requires WebGL; the share feature uploads files to an external service covered by a privacy policy.
intentEvidence: Obsidian port of the vscode-omni-viewer extension.
problem: Obsidian natively opens only a small set of file types, so formats like archives, notebooks, HAR captures, or ML models require leaving the app for external tools.

relations.evidence: Legacy viewers host the vscode extension's self-contained HTML templates in an iframe

summary: Multi-format viewer that opens audio, video, images, archives, PDFs, ML models, Jupyter notebooks, and many other file formats inside Obsidian, some editable.
